deviations: AGGREGATION SCOPE (documented in JoinedAgreement KDoc): joined rows are counted among SAMPLED rows only, so coverage = joined/sampled stays <= 1 by construction; a companion beside an UNSAMPLED decision row is schema-representable (the phase doc's guard names only answered-row and orphan cases, so the persistence guard lets it through per spec) but the aggregation fails loudly on it as incoherent rather than silently skewing metrics — strictness beyond the letter of the guard, consistent with the core 'cross-field consistency fails loudly' law.

AGREEMENT KL FOR THE JOIN IS RECOMPUTED FRESH from the stored distributions (uniform treatment of decision-row answers and companions) rather than reading the decision row's stored agreementKL; DecisionLogRow init only bounds stored KL at >= -1e-6, so fresh computation both matches the amendment wording ('computed over the joined view') and makes a corrupt stored value unable to skew the metric. Hand-computed gate values unaffected (stored == recomputed for lawful rows).

ROUTER CLOSE SEMANTICS: 'the logger is closed' is modeled as ShadowRouter.close() (the harness calls it after awaitIdle+snapshot, before the report reads the joined view); a companion-sink EXCEPTION (guard rejection or DB failure) is dropped+counted as companionRejected and surfaced via snapshot.lastFailure — loud within the shadow's log-only law (vision 02 §4.3 forbids an exception into the loop), with the truly-loud assertion of the guard itself living in ShadowResultDbTest (Gate 8B.1).

HARNESS JOINED COVERAGE READ is wrapped in runCatching with a log line so a DB read failure degrades the run report to the in-memory coverage fallback instead of crashing a headless run (harness-environment robustness, not product behavior; on-device gates 8.4/6.x unaffected).

PHASE-8 COUNTER PARITY KEPT: snapshot.completions keeps its Phase-8 increment sites (fireShadow success + enrich) — pre-existing double-count on the enrich path left as-is to avoid disturbing Phase-8 evidence semantics; the NEW companion counters (companionRows, droppedAfterClose, companionRejected) are separate and exact.
